metadata.description: Live-captured with tools/mock-capture --allow-error-status against UEM 26.2 on 2026-09-24, inside a disposable sdktestrun org group, on an object deleted moments earlier (the org group was deleted afterwards and a second DELETE on it returned 400, quirk 20). Status, errorCode and message are verbatim except that the real resource id (in the path and the message) is replaced by a fixed id chosen to be unique in this corpus; the activityId is the capture anonymizer's output. GET /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId} after a macOS internal app (created through the full-SLM upload path) was deleted: HTTP 401 with errorCode 7000, 'Application not found or user does not have access to it.'. client.IsNotFound requires errorCode exactly 7000 on a 401; a plain 401 stays an auth failure.

body.message: Application not found or user does not have access to it.
